name: Urgent transfer request from a claimed relative
description: A message claims to be a relative in urgent need, often from a new number, asks for an immediate transfer and discourages a call-back.

source_references.quote: Verify requests for urgent money transfers by calling directly your relatives/friends.

explanation.plain: Someone claiming to be a relative wants money urgently and does not want you to call. That pressure not to verify is the scam. Call them on their usual number first.
explanation.technical: CLAIMED_RELATIVE (identity) + payment demand + urgency/new-number/discourages-verification. CERT-In: verify urgent transfer requests by calling directly.
verification_steps: Call the relative on their known number before sending anything.
Be suspicious of 'new number' plus 'don't call me' together.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
